records.title: Eyes Wide Open: Ego Proactive Video-LLM for Streaming Video
records.reason: Compression is tightly scoped to egocentric streaming VideoLLM interaction; general LLM inference transfer is uncertain.

records.title: GSQ-Tuning: Group-Shared Exponents Integer in Fully Quantized Training for LLMs On-Device Fine-tuning
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.12913. GSQ-Tuning targets quantized on-device fine-tuning/training, not inference serving.

records.title: Dipper: Diversity in Prompts for Producing Large Language Model Ensembles in Reasoning tasks
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.15238. Dipper improves ensemble reasoning diversity/quality; ensembling adds computation and no efficiency gain is claimed.

records.title: Unified Parameter-Efficient Unlearning for LLMs
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.00383. Unified Parameter-Efficient Unlearning is outside inference-efficiency scope.

records.title: Learning Pattern-Specific Experts for Time Series Forecasting Under Patch-level Distribution Shift
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.09836. Addresses time-series forecasting under distribution shift, not LLM inference.
